lines.text: Your boss just stole your idea and called it his own!
He strutted into the big meeting, chest out, smiling at everyone.
You sat in the back, stared at him, and said nothing.
He clicked the remote to take all the credit.
But the very first slide said, created by you!
Then the speakers played his secret voicemail: I have no idea what I'm doing!
Everyone turned and stared. He tried to run, but slipped on the carpet.
Ten seconds later, he was still dizzy, staring at the ceiling.
Everyone in the room started clapping for you.
And that's the exact reason why
